insights.title: AI Confidence & Insights
insights.subtitle: Why the model sees this trend
insights.disclaimer: This breakdown is a transparent read of the technical factors below. It is derived from real indicator values, not from model internals, and it is not a promise of future price.
insights.trendAbove: Price is {pct}% above the 50-day average, and the 20-day sits above the 50-day.
insights.trendBelow: Price is {pct}% below the 50-day average, and the 20-day sits below the 50-day.
insights.trendMixed: Price is {pct}% away from the 50-day average with no clean alignment between the 20 and 50-day averages.
insights.rsiOverbought: RSI is {value} — overbought, a warning that an uptrend is stretched.
insights.rsiOversold: RSI is {value} — oversold, which often precedes a bounce.
insights.rsiCrossUp: RSI crossed up through 30 ({value}), a classic reversal signal.
insights.rsiCrossDown: RSI crossed down through 70 ({value}), a classic exhaustion signal.
insights.rsiNeutral: RSI is {value}, inside the neutral band between 30 and 70.
insights.macdAboveRising: MACD is above its signal line and the histogram is rising, so momentum is accelerating.
insights.macdAboveFalling: MACD is above its signal line but the histogram is falling, so momentum is fading.
insights.macdBelowRising: MACD is below its signal line while the histogram is rising, an early hint of a turn.
insights.macdBelowFalling: MACD is below its signal line and the histogram is falling, so the downtrend is still feeding itself.
insights.volumeSpike: Volume is {ratio}x the 20-day average, a spike that confirms the move.
insights.volumeQuiet: Volume is only {ratio}x the 20-day average, so conviction behind the move is thin.
insights.volumeNormal: Volume is {ratio}x the 20-day average, broadly in line with normal activity.
insights.bandsUpper: Price is pressing the upper band, so the move is extended.
insights.bandsLower: Price is riding the lower band, an overshoot to the downside.
insights.bandsMid: Price sits at {pct}% of the band width, comfortably inside the range.
insights.aligned: The technical factors above point the same way as the forecast.
insights.divergence: The technical factors lean the other way, so treat this forecast with extra caution.
insights.failed: Could not load the indicator evidence: {message}
